newsitem.title: USA: First Virginia and Premier Bankshares merge.
newsitem.headline: First Virginia and Premier Bankshares merge.

text.p: First Virginia Banks Inc said on Tuesday that it has definitively agreed to merge with Premier Bankshares Corp.

First Virginia said it will issue about 3,624,295 shares to Premier shareholders in a tax free exchange. Premier shareholders will receive .545 shares of First Virginia common for each of their 6.65 million outstanding shares, First Virginia said.
First Virginia said it would increase an existing stock repurchase program by 1.9 million shares to a 4 million share total.
First Virginia said it expects to make the repurchases over a few years and account for the merger as a purchase.
As part of the agreement, Premier has issued First Virginia a stock option to acquire up to 19.9 percent of Premier shares for $20 per share, First Virginia said.

The companies said the deal should close in the early second quarter of 1997. The three Premier banks will merge into First Virginia banks, and Premier directors will become board members of the merged banks, First Virginia said.
